source: Historical young-skater growth, NHL stats API 2008-09..2025-26 (Captains Dynasty scoring, era-adjusted; scratchpad/dynasty/youth/growth.cjs rows, fixtures by scratchpad/dynasty/fix2/fixtures2.cjs). rows: [D?1:0, base age, pick (null = undrafted), base FP/G, base season, ratio_1..ratio_6, base GP share, base FP (82-game basis), fp_1..fp_6] with ratio_k = FP/G k seasons later / base FP/G for survivors (>= 20 GP, 82-game basis), null otherwise, and fp_k = FP k seasons later on an 82-game basis, 0 when absent (zero-filled), null past 2025-26. strata: row indices, and per k = 1..5 the survivors' mean ratio with its cluster-bootstrap SE by player (2,000 resamples). iqr sets (representative base = median age / pick / FP/G / GP share of a stratum, or a 2025-26 player's own base and his 12-15 nearest analogs): [p25, p75] of the ratio and bootstrap SEs, for the simulated dispersion. oos: the growth block fitted on 2008-13 bases only and strata of the 2014-24 bases. debuts: FP/G quartiles of first NHL seasons (career GP <= 20 before, >= 30 GP prorated) at 18-19 by position and pick range (scratchpad/dynasty/av/rows.json).

params.source: Conditional growth of young NHL skaters (Captains Dynasty scoring, NHL stats API 2008-09..2025-26, era-adjusted FP/G; rows from scratchpad/dynasty/youth/growth.cjs, fitted by scratchpad/dynasty/growthmodel/fit.cjs). Base = a skater-season at 18-23 (Oct 1) with >= 30 GP (prorated); G_k = FP/G k seasons later / base FP/G among survivors (>= 20 GP), 2,653 base seasons. ln G_k = ln[c~(a+k)/c~(a)] (the lambda-scaled curve) x (1 + gamma h(pct)), h = max(0, (pct - 0.5)/0.5)^2 (above-median producers realize less of the curve's growth) + A(pos, age band, k) pooled excess over the curve + B(pos, production band, k) regression to the mean (empirical-Bayes shrunk, n0 = sigma2/tau2 by method of moments; non-increasing in production by pool-adjacent-violators) + beta x (ln pick - mean ln pick of the band) (pedigree; gamma and beta cluster-robust by player, shrunk by t2/(1+t2)) + v_k(pos, band)/2 (lognormal mean: the path shocks are mean-one; residual variance by production band). Joint alternating least squares. Age x production and pedigree band x production interaction cells: method-of-moments variance ~0 -> not used (additive model). Linear over the age-band centres and production-band centres (flat outside). Production = percentile of the base FP/G among same-position, same-age backtest rows (pctKnots at pctQuantiles). Young shocks by production band: v_1 = sigma0^2 + season^2 and v_k - v_1 = (k-1) persistent^2 (floors 0.05); the band's posterior sd widens sigma0.

pedigree.form: bilinear over lnPickCentre (top-10 / 11-32 / 33+ and undrafted) x pctCentre (<p50 / p50-75 / p75+), flat outside; cell[prod][ped] (ln G, every k)
